settings.retrieval: Reuse exact saved redacted questions and context; no retrieval changes or new embeddings
settings.calibration: Use the original classifiers and exact thresholds; no training or selection
settings.routing: Code combines the separate self-check, validated citations, unchanged retrieval signals and frozen calibrated wrongness
settings.citationPolicy: Retrieved IDs only; preserve pre-repair invalid counts; reject ambiguous/unknown IDs before scoring
settings.missingBaseline: Gemma 4B plain50 prior-method replay is generated locally and labelled as replayed, never as a previous saved run
settings.stopAfter: Stage 1; Stage 2 retrieval completeness requires a later instruction

localAnswer.citationRepairs: deterministic unambiguous identifier formatting/source aliases only

paired.intervalPolicy: Paired source-group bootstrap on common supported before/after labels; missing or failed items are visible separately and are not scored as failures.

summary.method: Full-credit answer rubric, raw citation invalidity before repair/rejection, grounded citation coverage, and answer/self-check parsing reported separately. Model sizes and cohorts are never pooled.

notes: Stage 1 changes answer generation, self-check and citation validation only. Retrieval and all calibration coefficients/thresholds are frozen.
Old Gemma 4B plain50 baseline is a newly measured prior-method replay, not a saved previous run.
Both answer and self-check latency/tokens are counted; warm-ups are separate.
Raw invalid citations are measured before validation; rejected IDs cannot be passed to scoring or routing as valid.
Full credit is automated rubric coverage; the independent deterministic method is not expert semantic gold.
The next stage is retrieval completeness. Do not proceed without a later instruction.
